text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Phew. The Barbell Clan and the Horseshoe 
Division have safely relocated... And 
that's all thanks to our senpai, right, 
Vodka?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, seriously...! We never would've 
finished carrying all this on our own...!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Well then, to make sure I never forget 
this kindness for the rest of my days, 
allow me to capture a memory with you, 
Senpai—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
I haven't done anything extraordinary, nor 
is there any obligation for you to address 
me as 'Senpai'—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: My 'junior' is in Funabashi, after all.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
(Ah, shoot...\nDid I go a bit too far with 
my words, perhaps...?)

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Aw. Did seeing Ma-chan's junior power make 
you miss your own juniors back in 
Funabashi...?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I get it... Heheh. We might not be able to 
replace them, but— we can at least help 
keep you from feeling lonely!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
You guys... Ah! U-Um, it's not like I'm 
feeling lonely or anything—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Well then, once again, to commemorate the 
founding of the Senpai Loneliness Busters! 
Say, Cheddaaar Cheeeese☆
